 About the match
 On this page you can find the Elche vs Real Betis match lineup for LaLiga — Round 12 - First Leg, on Sunday 08-11-2026, along with the substitutes and the players missing from the squad. Elche lines up in a 4-3-3 led by Dituro, while Real Betis sets up in a 4-2-3-1 led by Isco. Elche is led by head coach Martín Anselmi, while Real Betis is managed by Manuel Pellegrini. The match is played at Estadio Martinez Valero.
